audit_events_json_valid.name: audit_events_json_valid
audit_events_json_valid.value: (before_json IS NULL OR json_valid(before_json)) AND (after_json IS NULL OR json_valid(after_json))

lead_import_batches_counts_valid.name: lead_import_batches_counts_valid
lead_import_batches_counts_valid.value: rows_total >= 0 AND rows_created >= 0 AND rows_skipped >= 0 AND rows_created + rows_skipped <= rows_total

leads_email_normalized.name: leads_email_normalized
leads_email_normalized.value: email IS NULL OR email = lower(trim(email))

tasks_completed_consistent.name: tasks_completed_consistent
tasks_completed_consistent.value: (status = 'done' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'done' AND completed_at IS NULL)
